entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian and I were on our way to my..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian and I were on our way to my office. I was holding a mug of coffee in one hand and a folder of various documents in the other.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I don't want to cause further divi..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't want to cause further division among Sords because of this.”
entries.menuText: “I don't want to cause further division among Sords because of this.”

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "“Be careful with that box!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Be careful with that box!”

entries.speaker: Albin Clavin
entries.title: Albin Clavin: "“You can leave it there. Thank you...."
entries.dialogueText: “You can leave it there. Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we turned a corner, Lucian spoke..."
entries.dialogueText: As we turned a corner, Lucian spoke.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“The Aschraf anniversary is coming..."
entries.dialogueText: “The Aschraf anniversary is coming up soon. The most important day for the Bludish populace. Watani Aschraf is one of their symbols, as you know.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Be careful with that!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Be careful with that!”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Your presence at this event would..."
entries.dialogueText: “Your presence at this event would show your desire for a more unified Sordland. We will reap the benefits if you decide to go, I'm sure.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Why should I attend a Bludish anni..."
entries.dialogueText: “Why should I attend a Bludish anniversary?”
entries.menuText: “Why should I attend a Bludish anniversary?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You are right.”"
entries.dialogueText: “You are right.”
entries.menuText: “You are right.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“As I said, I believe this is an op..."
entries.dialogueText: “As I said, I believe this is an opportunity to portray yourself as a unifier, not a divider."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“It would send a clear message to t..."
entries.dialogueText: “It would send a clear message to the Bludish. Your President is with you. This will alleviate tensions.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian nodded."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian nodded.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We rounded another corner to reach..."
entries.dialogueText: We rounded another corner to reach the last corridor leading to my office.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian suddenly stopped in front of..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian suddenly stopped in front of one of the doors. The plaque that once said 'Vice President Petr Vectern' had been removed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The door was halfway open, and I co..."
entries.dialogueText: The door was halfway open, and I could see a few workers moving boxes around the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard Albin's voice from inside."
entries.dialogueText: I heard Albin's voice from inside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard Gloria's voice from behind..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard Gloria's voice from behind him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Another handyman dropped a heavy-lo..."
entries.dialogueText: Another handyman dropped a heavy-looking box on the desk. A crunching sound was heard from within.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Mr. President, this move requires..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President, this move requires my personal attention."

entries.dialogueText: One of them saw us, bowed his head and changed the name tag on the door to 'Vice President Lucian Galade'.
